item_short_desc: Rothco’s Leather Neck Identification Holder provides secure, convenient storage for your ID, license, or other important documents. This sleek ID holder features a transparent 3.25 inch x 2.25 inch window to display your ID clearly, along with a 33 inch chain for wearing it around your neck, ensuring easy access at all times. Its bi-fold design, secured with a hook & loop closure, keeps your belongings safe and protected. The internal pocket offers additional storage for credit cards, cash, or even the chain when not in use.
